title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (I)

articles.content_en: Article 1 After the implementation of the Company Law, where the People's Court has not yet concluded or newly accepts civil cases, and the civil acts or events occurred before the implementation of the Company Law, the laws, regulations and judicial interpretations in force at that time shall apply.

Article 2 Where a dispute arises from a civil act or event before the implementation of the Company Law and is brought to the People's Court for prosecution, if the laws, regulations and judicial interpretations in force at that time have no explicit provisions, the relevant provisions of the Company Law may be applied mutatis mutandis.

Article 3 Where a plaintiff brings an action to the People's Court on the grounds set forth in paragraph 2 of Article 22 and paragraph 2 of Article 75 of the Company Law, and the time limit prescribed by the Company Law is exceeded, the People's Court shall not accept the case.

Article 4 The period of continuous shareholding of 180 days or more as prescribed in Article 152 of the Company Law shall be the shareholding time that has expired at the time when the shareholder brings an action to the People's Court; the prescribed total shareholding of more than one percent of the company's shares refers to the aggregate of the shareholdings of two or more shareholders.

Article 5 When the People's Court conducts a retrial according to law of a case that has already become final before the implementation of the Company Law, the provisions of the Company Law shall not apply.
Article 6 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
